name: Compass Datacenters Hoffman Estates campus
aliases: Former Sears headquarters data center campus
summary: Compass Datacenters is redeveloping the former Sears headquarters site, nearly 200 acres in Hoffman Estates about 30 miles west of Chicago, into a hyperscale campus of five data centers. Compass closed on the site in September 2023 and held a kickoff in June 2024, saying demolition of the old Sears buildings would start that summer and data center construction would follow in 2025. Compass put local investment at about USD 10 billion once operational, a figure the village mayor called preliminary, and its markets page lists the campus at 200 MW. In October 2026 Compass still described the campus as being developed.

location.note: Wikipedia coordinates for Hoffman Estates. The campus occupies the former Sears headquarters site in the village; no cited source gives site coordinates.
